The Ni-Cr-W Ni-based superalloy ingots and the TiC-Ni mixed powder package after removing the oxide layer and surface oil were placed in the melting crucible of the vacuum induction melting furnace, and the heating was started after the vacuum was evacuated to 5 × 10^1 Pa, and the melting power was 28 KW.

After the alloy raw material was completely melted, the temperature was continued to be raised to 1550 ± 10 ◦C for 8 min, so that the melt was fully convected under the action of the induced current, and the added TiC particles were uniformly distributed. After the heat preservation, the melt was cooled to 1450 ± 5 ◦C, and then the melt was quickly poured into the heat preservation mold.
The hot isostatic pressing temperature was 1170 ± 5 ◦C, the holding pressure was ≥ 120 MPa, and the holding time was 4 h.
The solution treatment temperature was 1170 ± 5 ◦C, the solution time was 2 h, and the air cooled to room temperature.
The aging temperature was 840 ± 5 ◦C, the holding time is 10 h, and the furnace was cooled to room temperature.
